paragraphs: On Sunday afternoon, Lily, Mia, and Leo stood in Lily's kitchen. Teacher Kim wanted every child to bring a snack for the club trip to the nature park. Mom put a sharp knife and some eggs on the table. "I will use the knife," she said. "You can wash the fruit and read the recipes." Pip sat next to the table and watched the eggs. The trip was on the next Saturday, so the children had to decide that day.

"Let's bake cookies!" said Leo. "Cookies are tasty, and everybody likes them." "I don't agree," said Lily. "Cookies are not very healthy, and we will walk a long way in the park." "You are right," said Mia, "but I love cookies." "We can bake a few cookies and make something healthy, too," said Lily. "Good idea," said Leo.

"What healthy snack can we make?" asked Mia. "We can make boiled eggs," said Lily. "Eggs are good for you, and they are easy to carry." "I don't like eggs," said Leo. "But I like mushroom sandwiches!" "I disagree," said Mia. "A mushroom is soft and cold in a sandwich, and I don't like it." "Then we will not make mushroom sandwiches," said Lily. "Let's ask Mom."

"Boiled eggs are simple," said Mom. "Put them in water for ten minutes." Lily put four eggs in a pot, and Mom turned on the cooker. Mom gave Leo the recipe for the cookies on a small card. Leo mixed butter, sugar, and flour for the cookies. "Use only a little sugar," said Lily. "Then the cookies are healthier." "Fine, I agree," said Leo.

After ten minutes, Mom took the eggs out of the hot water. The cookies baked for fifteen minutes, and the kitchen smelled sweet. Mom cut one egg with the knife and gave a small piece to each child. Leo ate his piece slowly. "It is not bad!" he said. "I will bring cookies, you bring eggs, and Mia can bring bananas," said Lily. "I agree," said Mia, and Leo smiled. Lily wrote the plan on a card and put it on the kitchen wall. Pip looked at the cookies and said, "Woof!"
text.summary: Lily, Mia, and Leo choose a snack for the club trip. They do not agree about cookies, eggs, and mushrooms, and then they find a plan for all three friends.
